thread:
Kaitlyn: Quick sync — final checklist for tomorrow's release. Need: changelog link, docs push link, canary timing, bench narrative blurbs for the launch post, webinar CTA copy, and inbound lead routing plan. Who's owning what?
Devon: I can take changelog + docs link. Will push final changelog to the repo and post link here in ~30m.
Priya: I'll own webinar CTA and landing page copy. Can someone add the canonical docs URL once Devon has it so I can wire the CTA?
Marco: I'll do rollout timing + canary schedule. Current plan: canary start 09:00 PT, 30m monitor, then 50% at 09:45, 100% at 10:30 with fallback to v1 if errors > 3%. Oncall ping chain = eng-oncall -> Marco -> Devon.
Kaitlyn: Perfect. For bench narrative: we want 2 quick callouts — latency median improvement and cost/unit reduction. Keep numbers rounded. Priya can weave them into the email/webinar slides.
Devon: changelog draft uploaded: https://git.company/repo/releases/1791234/changelog.md  (WIP)
Devon: docs PR opened: https://docs.company/pull/812 — will merge after a quick tech review.
Priya: Got the links, thx. Draft CTA copy: "Join our launch webinar — see how 2x throughput and 30% lower per-token cost make it easier to ship at scale." Thoughts?
Marco: CTA sounds good. Might soften the 2x claim to "up to 2x" unless benchmark team signs off.
Kaitlyn: Good call. Let's use "up to 2x" pending final bench numbers. @Devon can you tag the bench owners to confirm final figures?
Devon: tagging bench leads in PR comments now. Also adding a short note in changelog about the fallback policy and canary timing.
CI-bot: Build 1791234/docs passed ·  ✅  — docs PR ready for merge once reviewers approve.
Priya: Webinar logistics — we have 45 mins slot. Need a quick slide that shows before/after perf, a short demo script (30s), and 10-15m Q&A. Who will run the demo?
Marco: I'll run the demo with the telemetry view up. Need a 1-liner for security/compliance for Private customers in the deck.
Kaitlyn: I'll draft the security one-liner and circulate. Also prepping two tweet-length headlines for social.
Devon: Docs PR merged. Final docs link: https://docs.company/release/1791234 — use that for CTA and changelog ref.
Priya: Updated CTA: "Join our launch webinar — see how up to 2x throughput and ~30% lower per-token cost help you scale production inference." Using the docs link now.
Marco: Canary schedule confirmed in ops playbook. I'll post the playbook snippet here before EOD.
Kaitlyn: Inbound lead routing — recommend: webhook from webinar signup -> HubSpot list "Launch 1791234" -> SDR triage. @Priya can you create the form with hidden utm=launch_1791234?
Priya: Yep, creating form now and wiring the webhook to HubSpot. Will share the webhook endpoint.
Devon: One more: changelog short bullet for release post. Draft: "Reduced median token latency by up to 25% and introduced a new routing policy that reduces serving cost by ~30% on chat workloads." Feedback?
Marco: Fine with that if bench confirms 25%. Keep the routing policy blurb generic.
Kaitlyn: Bench leads approved metrics: latency 22% median improvement, cost reduction 28% typical. We'll round to "up to 2x" throughput and "~30%" cost in marketing copy.
Priya: Landing page and webinar invite updated with final links and numbers. Form webhook: https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/1791234.
CI-bot: Deploy window reserved for 09:00 PT — status: approved by release-coordinator.
Kaitlyn: Everyone, please add any final copy edits by 16:30 PT. After that we'll lock the release notes and marketing assets. :thumbsup:
Devon: Done — added a short code snippet to the docs showing new client config for canary fallback:
Devon: ```json
{"routingPolicy": "canary", "fallback": "v1", "canaryWindow": 1800}
```
Marco: Playbook snippet: will paste here after I confirm incident callbacks.
Priya: All set from my side. Landing page live in staging.
Kaitlyn: Thanks all — we'll do a 15m pre-launch check at 08:30 PT in #release-war-room. I'll ping there. :rocket:
